t: This is the Odeon Covent Garden, a cinema on Shaftesbury Avenue that began as a theatre. The building is the former Saville Theatre, which opened in 1931 and became a music venue during the 1960s. In 1970 it became a cinema. The architects credited with it are Bertie Crewe, one of the leading English theatre designers of the boom between 1885 and 1915, and Thomas Bennett, who was later responsible for much of the development of the new towns of Crawley and Stevenage.
